text: On data_seed 1, fresh seeds 22-23 drop about 0.10-0.11 in force margin from N=64 to N=128, against 0.064-0.072 for seeds 20-21. The trained-R2 drop is about 0.08-0.10 in all four seeds. Across all six to seven seeds with paired N=64 and N=128 runs on data_seeds 0 and 1, is the per-seed trained force R2 drop tighter, with a lower coefficient of variation, than the margin drop? Is it about 0.10 on both datasets?
